sentence: This project uses ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging to measure liver fibrosis, portal hypertension, and bile duct dilatation in polycystic kidney disease.
This project studies how a family of ion channels affects blood flow in the aging brain.
This project uses deep learning to predict tissue and clinical outcome in stroke from imaging and clinical data.
This project studies how cancer-associated fibroblasts stop chimeric antigen receptor T cells from working in multiple myeloma.
This project runs a shared center that gives vision researchers access to equipment and technical support.
This project studies how viruses enriched in dinucleotides affect immune responses during West Nile virus infection.
This project tests an imaging tracer for detecting heart damage caused by chemotherapy in breast cancer and lymphoma patients.
This project builds a cartilage aging-on-a-chip model to study how chondrocytes age in a knee joint.
This project uses many factors measured in blood to find groups of biologically similar individuals with cardiometabolic diseases.
This project studies how chemical exposure, temperature and oxygen changes together affect behavior and energy use where pollution resistance has evolved.
This project identifies substance use needs in communities and carries out clinical trials to address them.
This project studies how microbial and genetic factors contribute to inflammatory bowel disease in high-risk families.
This project provides DNA sequencing, bioinformatics support and molecular imaging services to help investigators with their research.
This project provides financial and administrative oversight for a program studying how long noncoding RNAs contribute to herpesvirus-associated disease and cancer.
This project studies how RNA-binding proteins, which bind and regulate mRNAs, affect how cancer progresses.
This project studies how neuromodulators and neuropeptides shape how the brain assigns positive or negative meaning, and how stress alters this.
This project provides bioinformatics analysis and statistical support for high-throughput experiments and develops methods of data analysis.
This project studies how nicotinic acetylcholine receptors work in healthy and diseased states.
This project studies the role of a transmembrane protein in bronchial epithelial cells and in asthma.
This project studies how clotting factors work together to regulate blood coagulation in bleeding disorders.
